verdict.rationale: Rainforest offers documented, agent-readable surfaces: an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, server API keys, an llms.txt index with .md page versions, and webhooks. On the money side it documents deposits (payouts) and offers an embeddable chargebacks component. However, nothing shows API endpoints for reading balances, tracing a missing payout, or drafting and submitting dispute evidence, and the probed OpenAPI file paths returned 404. Missing for 10: documented balance read endpoints, payout/deposit lookup for investigating missing payouts, API-level dispute evidence submission, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI file, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of agent use.
